rules: b_work/step1/schema.md v1.2 Section 4; b_work/step1/labeling_guide.md v1.1 Section 1.1
evidence_reference: Each evidence item is [document title, sentence index], as in supporting_facts. build_gold.py converts it to an evidence ID.
title_assumption: Evidence is shown together with its document title, as in HotpotQA. A sentence whose subject is the article's topic ('He won...', 'The team was created...') stands alone. Sentences that need an earlier sentence for other content ('The pair...', sentence fragments) are cited together with it.

notes: Comparison (yes/no): two fact units plus a conclusion unit.
Osbeckia octandra and Osbeckia aspera sentence 0 explicitly name the genus Osbeckia and its family, so they are alternative support for u2.
The Gordonia species sentences and Osbeckia stellata do not mention the genus; linking a species to its genus by name is an inference, so they are excluded. This narrows review note Q19.

Strict exclusion kept after the trace audit (2026-10-23): Osbeckia stellata sentence 0 arrives in batch 1 of split traces, so a model that answers from it is scored unsupported. This is an intended hard case.
Trap: Gondysia similis ('Gordonia Darkwing') is a moth in Noctuidae.
